text: {"lessons":["I sold several stocks after gains, but a quick rise alone is not a reason to sell; I should weigh each position's prospects and my plan.","After selling, I made no trades for many months; checking periodically and reassessing holdings can help me avoid neglecting risks or clinging to losing positions.","My account value fluctuated but ended above where it began, and this short record cannot prove which choices worked; I should avoid reacting to short-term moves and follow a consistent approach."]}
